about description: A fast, offline-first code editor and web IDE for Android. Forked from Acode, rebuilt with AI assistance, Git integration and a Linux terminal in your pocket.
credits acode desc: XCoder is a fork of the awesome Acode editor
credits contributors desc: Everyone who improves XCoder on GitHub
credits community desc: Testers, translators and bug reporters — thank you!

settings-info-fb-backup: Signs in anonymously and saves your settings and AI chats to Firestore (xcoder_users/<uid>/sync/backup). Requires Anonymous sign-in enabled in your Firebase project.
settings-info-fb-restore: Restores settings (token excluded) and AI chats from the last Firebase backup made on this device.
settings-info-firebase-enabled: Optional anonymous usage events via the Firestore REST API (no SDK). No events are sent when disabled.
settings-info-firebase-key: The Web API key from your Firebase project settings (public by design).
settings-info-gh-backup: Commits your settings and AI chats as JSON to db/xcoder/backup.json in the backend repo.
settings-info-gh-branch: Branch used to store the JSON documents.
settings-info-gh-repo: Your own repository used as a backend for settings/chat backups and files. Accepts owner/repo or a github.com URL.
settings-info-gh-restore: Restores settings (token excluded) and AI chats from the last backup.
settings-info-gh-token: Fine-grained PAT with Contents read/write on the backend repo only. Stored on this device.
settings-info-gh-oauth-client-id: Client id of your own GitHub OAuth App with Device Flow enabled — used by 'Sign in with GitHub' in the Git panel.
settings-info-horizontal-scroll-margin: Adds empty space after the longest line when word wrap is off. Enter any non-negative whole-pixel value.

settings-note-formatter-settings: Assign a formatter to each language. Install formatter plugins to unlock more options.
settings-note-lsp-settings: Language servers add autocomplete, diagnostics, hover details, and more. They work best with folders that XCoder's built-in terminal can access directly, such as terminal/public folders. SAF, external, and remote locations are skipped by default because they may use cached or virtual paths; enable the compatibility option only if you want to try them.
